sections.description: Calls without a user.id are left out.

sections.title: Orgs
sections.description: Calls without an org.id are left out.

title: shop: AI by user
description: Who the model calls were made for: the users and orgs with the most calls and tokens, by their opaque ids (user.id, org.id; genai.WithScope stamps them). From the GenAI spans in the environment's traces, so the range is bounded by their retention.

panels.title: Users with model calls
panels.description: Distinct users with a model call each UTC day.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact(SpanAttributes['user.id']) AS "Users"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND SpanAttributes['user.id'] != ''
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Top users
panels.description: Users by tokens in the range: their runs, model calls, tokens, reported cost and when they last made a call.
panels.sql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS "User", uniqExactIf(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'], SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '') AS "Runs", count() AS "Calls",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS "Input tokens", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output tokens",
       round(sum(toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd']))), 4) AS "Reported cost (USD)", max(Timestamp) AS "Last call"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND SpanAttributes['user.id'] != ''
GROUP BY "User" ORDER BY "Input tokens" + "Output tokens" DESC, "User" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Top orgs
panels.description: Orgs by tokens in the range, measured as the users.
panels.sql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS "Org", uniqExactIf(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'], SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '') AS "Runs", count() AS "Calls",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS "Input tokens", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output tokens",
       round(sum(toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd']))), 4) AS "Reported cost (USD)", max(Timestamp) AS "Last call"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND SpanAttributes['org.id'] != ''
GROUP BY "Org" ORDER BY "Input tokens" + "Output tokens" DESC, "Org" LIMIT 50
